title: Joint Sampling Frequency Offset Estimation and Compensation Algorithms Based on the Farrow Structure
summary: This paper presents joint sampling frequency offset (SFO) estimation and compensation algorithms based on the Farrow structure. Unlike conventional approaches that treat estimation and compensation separately, the proposed framework exploits the interpolator structure to enable a low-complexity, fully time-domain solution applicable to arbitrary bandlimited signals, without imposing constraints on the waveform or requiring Fourier transform based processing.
